description: This PHP script handles user export functionality for the TestLink project, including initializing parameters, setting up the GUI, and exporting user data to XML files.

classes.name: ADODB_XML
classes.description: A class used to convert database query results into XML format.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments, returning an object with action parameters and userID.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI configuration object with title, filename defaults, and export options.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Executes an export of user data from the database into an XML file, saving it to the specified filename.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the user has rights to manage users.
